data.one_liner: Cross-platform plugin for native Airship iOS and Android SDKs.
data.what_it_does: Provides cross-platform access to native Airship iOS and Android SDK features such as push notifications, live activities, in-app experiences, message centers, analytics, and feature flags. It simplifies integrating Airship services into Flutter applications.
use_when: You need to integrate Airship push notifications and messaging into a Flutter app.
You require advanced user segmentation, feature flags, or message center capabilities provided by Airship.
avoid_when: Your project targets iOS versions older than 16.0 or Android API levels lower than 26.
You are using CocoaPods on iOS, as Swift Package Manager is strictly required.
strengths: Official Airship plugin supporting rich push notifications, live activities, and in-app experiences.
Keeps pace with native iOS and Android SDK updates.
Provides built-in analytics, contact management, and preference centers.
weaknesses: Drops CocoaPods support in favor of Swift Package Manager on iOS.
Raises the minimum Android SDK requirement to 26 and minimum Flutter version to 3.44.0.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling Swift Package Manager on iOS (flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager), minimum Android SDK 26, and initializing Airship in main() with your app credentials.
